text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's the final stretch!
Who will be the one
to claim
the glory of winning the Derby?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Everything hurts and burns. I want to
stop
running. If I push myself any more,
my lungs might
burst.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The lead is mine! The lead... is mine!
Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Not so! I'll be the one to take first!
I will
engrave
my name here upon this race,
this very Derby!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I don't want to lose, I don't want to lose, I don't! This is my Derby!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: This is Maruzen's and my...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Derbyyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But I... I...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O's face is contorted in
ripe pain
as the reality of her loss settles
onto her with
finality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But despite how miserable she feels
now, there's
no way I can let this setback
stop her in her
tracks.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But... this Derby... This Derby was my
dream...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And now it's over. Everything's ove—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So when... when that happens, when I'm

stronger... Will you run with me again?
choice_data_list: No, you still have a goal to striv...
No, you still have a goal to striv...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: There's no time to stand still.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I'm sorry. You're right.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've still got a long way to go if I'm
going
to catch
up with Maruzen, let alone beat
her!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Chiyo... You've gotten so strong.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for taking on my dream. I'll
never
forget this Derby. Ever.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And now it's my turn to fulfill my final
promise
with you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's run together sometime. And when
we do, I
hope you'll accept one more
gift from me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even as Tokyo Racecourse is still buzzing
with excitement, a new resolution is
carved into
Sakura Chiyono O and the
others' hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's race has proven to be an
important
milestone for them all...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Wait.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Things can't just end like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O is all packed up and
ready to
go, so we leave the waiting
room together.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sigh... It seemed so far away when we began, but now it feels like our journey to the Derby was over in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking. When I first started
racing, my
goal was to win the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I chased after Maruzen and she gave me
her
dream, so I wanted to win for her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But at some point, it stopped being just
about winning—I also didn't want to
lose. Those feelings
kept propelling my
legs forward...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And when I finally crossed the finish
line,
I found
myself wishing the race could've
gone on longer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to fight for the lead with Yaeno
and
Ardan forever. I wanted to keep
running until the
stars burn out.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I never knew how motivating it would be
to have
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Yeah! Now, then! What's next?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Now that my big goal race is over, I've
gotta work on getting strong enough to
run against Maruzen. I could aim for the
Kikuka Sho or the autumn
Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
S-someone call an ambulance! Quickly!
We need
a stretcher!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: Ardan... Mejiro Ardan has collapsed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the music from the concert fades,
the next
thing we hear is the shrill siren
of a wailing
ambulance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O, her face pale, holds
Mejiro Ardan's hand and speaks to her
as her friend is
taken to the hospital on a
stretcher.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan's own face is slick with
sweat as Sakura Chiyono O reassures
her. But she finds the strength to
squeeze her friend's hand in return... and
smiles, satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a thorough exam, it turns out that
Mejiro Ardan's legs have become
extremely weak due to
how hard she's
been pushing herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'll be in and out of the hospital for 
treatment... And it seems unlikely that
she'll be
able to return to the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You came to see me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A-Ardan. Um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to act that way. This
outcome is
all part of the price I knew I
would have to pay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, this is proof that a miracle
happened.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because of my poor health, I've
always been
hyperaware of my body...
and my limits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, that awareness began
to destroy me. I was always thinking of
how I couldn't go
further or push myself
harder.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But then I saw you. You weren't a
natural-born superstar; you were a
normal Umamusume
fighting so hard to
overcome your limits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You inspired me to keep pushing myself,
and you
gave me the determination to
race against you
with all I had.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I witnessed a miracle at the Derby. I no
longer
have any regrets left in this world.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-you... You can't mean...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The preparations have already
begun.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O, I'm sure you'll find new rivals
in the
future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Just please don't forget that I, Mejiro
Ardan, the Umamusume who struggled
against her fate so
she could shine, was
once one of them.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...I won't forget that. Ever.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So you can't forget that I'm your rival
either...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm going to make you regret
this
decision.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Having a rival is incredible.
Just thinking about
not wanting to lose to them fills
you up with tons more strength than you
usually have.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you felt that strength before
you crossed
the finish line at the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So even if you don't have any regrets
now, so
long as you still regard me as
your rival in your
heart...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I know you'll want to race again. I'm sure
we'll
compete against each other once
more someday!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I swear, I'll make you rue this decision.
And when
you do, I'll meet you on the
racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Now, if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Of course. Didn't you hear what I just
told her?
choice_data_list: Do you truly have no regrets?
Do you really have no regrets at all?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I said I have no regrets left in this
world,
and
surely I would not lie...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I... I'm going to become much, much
stronger,
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Cause I'm not going to lose to you next
time we
race, either!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O trembles as she holds
back her
tears. It seems she's found
another source of
strength.
